title: SuRaksha Mesh: choose the visual world
question: One world carries the city twin, corridor BEV, X-ray mode, cockpit HUD and phone app. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Live Survey Sheet
options.lineage: Survey of India toposheets, translated into a live 3D clay-model twin
options.thesis: Road risk drawn the way surveyors draw terrain: contour isolines of danger over a white clay city, threats placed as survey benchmarks.
materials: matte white clay massing model of the real city
survey linework: risk isolines, benchmark triangles, graduated frame edge only (no background grid)
Mona Sans variable width with Martian Mono figures
options.viewport: Full-bleed clay-white 3D corridor in raking light; violet risk isolines around a free-left turn; a vermilion benchmark pulsing over a hidden pedestrian; a sheet-title block carries corridor, scale and live counters.
options.risk: Reads as a printed map rather than a live system if motion and depth are timid; the night cockpit must invert the sheet without falling into neon.

raised.raise: One plot owns each view: the corridor risk ridgeline (risk by hour) is the only chart on the city sheet.
The threat lifecycle shows as same-scale registered plates: noticed, potential, confirmed, resolved.
Irreversible actions (broadcast critical alert, dispatch work order) stand alone with deliberate empty space.

options.label: Glass Cockpit / TCAS
options.lineage: airliner EFIS displays and TCAS traffic symbology
options.thesis: Every car is traffic on a collision-avoidance display: threat state carried by symbol shape (hollow diamond, filled diamond, amber circle, red square).
materials: range rings around the ego car
options.viewport: Black glass, the ego car centred in range rings, nearby cars as traffic symbols, the street fading in behind as X-ray depth.
options.risk: The most familiar route: closest to the dark-neon dashboard look most runs in this category ship.

options.label: Sodium Line Rail
options.lineage: glass spectrograms on a light box, and sodium-vapour street lighting
options.thesis: Threat state carried by line form, not colour: solid confirmed, dashed potential, half-height stale, doubled sodium yellow for critical.
options.viewport: Charcoal night road, each upcoming threat a hairline on a distance rail; the critical one doubled in sodium yellow.
options.case: Wins on clarity (state readable without colour, ideal in-car) but drivers and juries do not recognise spectrograms.
options.risk: Can read abstract and cold on the 3D city views.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairline seams, accents only for state.
options.viewport: Tiled persistent panels around a map.
options.case: Loses on audience (generic ops look) and adds nothing to clarity.
options.risk: It is the rut the brief rejects.
options.kept: Irreversible actions isolated by empty space.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Matte black, one white-line pulse plot owns the field.
options.viewport: One stacked pulse plot of corridor risk.
options.case: Coded labels hurt clarity; the audience does not identify with it.
options.kept: One plot owns each view (corridor risk ridgeline).

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One subject through its stages at fixed scale.
options.viewport: Five same-scale plates in a row.
options.case: A cream editorial world does not fit drivers or operators.
options.kept: Threat lifecycle as registered same-scale plates.

options.label: Guide Map Lobes
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes divided by coastlines.
options.case: Playful tone contradicts road safety; loses both axes.
options.kept: One geometry drives layout and state (risk isolines also clip the layers).

options.label: Character Roster
options.thesis: A ranked roster with fixed furniture per entry.
options.kept: Blackspot segments as a ranked finite roster, each with first-reported date and a one-line note.

canonCard.label: Smart-city command centre
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships: navy-black dashboards, neon cyan accents, glowing map, KPI tiles.
canonCard.viewport: Dark 3D city with neon traffic, KPI tiles on both sides.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other smart-city demo by design.
